selection_criterion: Highest mean 5-fold CV average precision (PR-AUC) on the training set; the test set was not used for selection.

risk_band_rules.moderate: Lowest cut-off with OOF precision >= 0.7 and recall >= 0.8 on the training set (5-fold OOF).
risk_band_rules.high: 0.5 - the model's default classification threshold. Project-defined bands, not validated industrial limits.

logistic_regression.description: Linear baseline. Standardized features, SMOTE resampling inside the pipeline; coefficients are easy to interpret.

random_forest.description: Bagged decision trees with balanced class weights; robust to non-linear effects and feature scaling.

hist_gradient_boosting.description: Gradient boosting on decision trees with balanced class weights; usually strongest on tabular data.
